performances.venue: Northwell Health at Jones Beach Theater

performances.jam: In its second outing since the Halloween debut, this "Sci-Fi Soldiers" track shakes off its liquid handcuffs and stretches into a Trey led melodic journey that manages to provide a lot of ear candy in just under 13 minutes.

performances.venue: William Randolph Hearst Greek Theatre, University of California, Berkeley
performances.jam: The first set-opening "Don't Doubt Me" kicks off a heavily jammed set. This jam traverses an effects-laden soundscape before giving way to a light, ethereal jam to end things before > "Kill Devil Falls".
